about_the_game:
Funds raised from selling this game will be spent on saving lives of our little friends.
Every cat found in-game contributes to helping a real one in need.

Find Meow in Dwarf Mines is a cozy hidden object game where you explore hand-drawn Dwarf Mines to find 100 charming cats, each one carefully hidden and full of personality.

Relax, explore at your own pace, and enjoy a peaceful journey filled with lovely meows.

Features

🐱 100 unique cats to find — each one hand-placed with love

🎨 Custom color painting — choose your favorite color to mark found cats

🎵 Relaxing soundtrack — gentle background music to accompany your exploration

🌍 Large hand-drawn map — explore every corner to uncover all hidden cats

💡 Hint system — a hint button appears once you find 90 cats

🏆 Achievements support — track your progress and unlock Steam achievements

💾 Progress saving — continue your journey anytime

🔁 Replay-friendly — reset and enjoy again anytime

🖱️ Simple point-and-click controls — intuitive and accessible for everyone
